verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity tracks verification through a Verification Sessions API that shows results on completion, emits events on every status change for webhook-driven automation, and exposes verification details and extracted document data programmatically, so an automated onboarding flow can branch on session status. The pack never documents structured failure-reason codes or risk scores, and fraud detection is mentioned only as an internal process. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable failure/error codes, exposed risk signals or scores, per-check result fields, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven branching.
